name: Target
notes: Price Match Guarantee covers Target's own lower price (store or Target.com) within 14 days after purchase.

return_window_days.quote: Most unopened items sold by Target in new condition and returned within 90 days will receive a refund or exchange.

exchange_window_days.quote: Most unopened items sold by Target in new condition and returned within 90 days will receive a refund or exchange.

allowed.quote: It may qualify for a price match if it's an eligible Target product, bought from Target today, or in the past 14 days.

window_days.quote: It may qualify for a price match if it's an eligible Target product, bought from Target today, or in the past 14 days.

conditions.value: Must be an eligible Target product bought from Target
conditions.quote: It may qualify for a price match if it's an eligible Target product, bought from Target today, or in the past 14 days.

conditions.value: Must be the identical item (brand name, size, weight, color, quantity and model number) and the price is lower on Target.com or at your local Target store
conditions.quote: It must be an identical item, brand name, size, weight, color, quantity and model number and the price is lower from Target.com or your local Target store.

conditions.value: Have the current lower price ready from the digital ad, Target.com or the Target App
conditions.quote: Have the current price you want to match ready - the digital ad, Target.com or the Target App.

conditions.value: Screenshots or pictures are not accepted as proof
conditions.quote: Screenshots or pictures cannot be accepted.

conditions.value: Online purchases: have order number and item information ready
conditions.quote: Have your order number and item information ready.

conditions.value: Store purchases: bring the original receipt
conditions.quote: Bring the original receipt if you already purchased the item.

conditions.value: Not available for store purchases when the lower price is from a different Target store
conditions.quote: If you bought it in a Target store, and the lower price is from a different Target store.

conditions.value: Not available if a promotional Target GiftCard was received with the original purchase
conditions.quote: If you received a promotional Target GiftCard as part of the original purchase.

conditions.value: Not available if the product currently has a Target GiftCard promotion
conditions.quote: Or, if the product currently has a Target GiftCard offered as part of a promotion.

conditions.value: Not available when also using a Registry completion coupon or other Target coupons
conditions.quote: You're also using a Registry completion coupon or other Target coupons.

conditions.value: Excludes clearance, closeout, liquidation, refurbished items and typographical errors
conditions.quote: The item is on clearance, closeout, liquidation, refurbished or is a typographical error.
